description:
From the 2026-07 remediation batch (#1176 e2e): once tuning constraints
actually reach the engine, loading TPC-H with the shipped tpch_tuned.yaml
(foreign_keys.enabled: true) fails because tables load in an order that
violates FK references (e.g. lineitem before orders). Invisible for months
because tuning never reached the engine. Reproduce (duckdb SF 0.01, shipped
template), then fix by dependency-ordering the load sequence from schema FK
metadata or deferring FK creation to post-load (choose per-engine semantics;
post-load ALTER is the portable default).

anti_patterns.dont: silently disable FK enforcement to make the run pass

preserves.behavior: Applied-ledger records the constraint statements actually executed
Untuned/notuning load behavior and timings-attribution (constraint work must not silently inflate load phase without being visible in phase metadata)

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m benchbox.cli.main run --platform duckdb --benchmark tpch --scale 0.01 --tuning tuned --non-interactive --output /tmp/fk-check
verifications.description: E2E tuned run with shipped template passes (original command; does not exercise FK enforcement on develop until PR #1176 merges -- see substitution below)
verifications.expected: Run completes; bundle status applied_unverified; FK constraints present

verifications.command: BENCHBOX_SKIP_TEST_LOCK=1 uv run -- python -m pytest tests/integration/tuning/test_duckdb_fk_load_ordering.py -v -m slow
verifications.description: SUBSTITUTED verification (develop lacks PR #1176's tuning-delivery fix): adapter-level FK-enforced tuned load + constraint-enforcement + ordering tests

work_units.notes:
E2E command from this TODO's verification section does NOT reproduce
on develop: -vv logs show foreign_keys=False reaching the adapter
even with foreign_keys.enabled: true in tpch_tuned.yaml (PR #1176's
tuning-delivery fix isn't merged yet). Reproduced instead by setting
adapter.unified_tuning_configuration directly (bypassing the
delivery gap, exercising the real constraint-application path) and
loading real SF 0.01 TPC-H data via DuckDBAdapter.load_data in the
then-current alphabetical fallback order: every table except
part/region (no FK deps) failed with "Violates foreign key
constraint" (e.g. lineitem before orders, customer before nation).
work_units.summary: Reproduce with the shipped template on duckdb SF 0.01; capture the exact failure

work_units.notes:
Chose FK-aware load ordering, not post-load ALTER: verified DuckDB
1.3.2 rejects ALTER TABLE ... ADD FOREIGN KEY ("No support for that
ALTER TABLE option yet!"), so the "portable default" doesn't work on
this engine. Added benchbox.core.schema_primitives.
get_fk_ordered_table_names (stable topo-sort over
BaseSchemaTable.get_foreign_keys()), benchbox.core.tpch.schema.
get_table_loading_order(), and TPCHBenchmark.get_table_loading_order
-- the same hasattr(benchmark, "get_table_loading_order") extension
point benchbox/platforms/base/data_loading.py already uses for
TPC-DS. Constraint application itself (apply_constraint_configuration,
inline CREATE TABLE FK clauses) is untouched.
work_units.summary: Implement fix (FK-aware load order or post-load constraint application) with rationale

work_units.notes:
tests/integration/tuning/test_duckdb_fk_load_ordering.py (real
DuckDB + real generated SF 0.01 data, FK enforcement forced on via
the same bypass as w0): tuned load completes with nonzero rows in
every table; a violating INSERT into orders is still rejected
post-load; TPCHBenchmark.get_table_loading_order returns a
dependency-safe order for the real loader's table set. Unit
coverage added in tests/unit/core/test_tpch_schema_helpers.py
(topo-sort correctness, stability, cycle-safety) and
tests/unit/core/test_tpch_benchmark_fakes.py (benchmark-level
ordering against a shuffled available_tables list).
work_units.summary: Tests: tuned run with FK enforcement completes; constraint actually enforced post-load (violation insert rejected)

work_units.notes:
Opus review flagged that SSB (lineorder -> customer/part/supplier/
date) and CoffeeShop (order_lines -> dim_locations/dim_products)
have the same latent defect: no get_table_loading_order, so the
alphabetical fallback would violate SSB's FKs the moment tuning
delivery is fixed (ssb_tuned.yaml already ships foreign_keys
enabled). Added schema_primitives._DottedForeignKeyTable +
get_fk_ordered_table_names_from_column_specs() to adapt SSB/
CoffeeShop's dict-based schema_specs.yaml (dotted "table.column"
foreign_key strings) onto the existing get_fk_ordered_table_names
topo-sort unchanged; wired get_table_loading_order into both
schema.py modules and both benchmark classes. Also corrected the
get_fk_ordered_table_names docstring's self-reference claim.
TPC-DS/Data Vault already have ordering and were left alone.
work_units.summary: Post-review: extend FK-aware load ordering to SSB and CoffeeShop; fix a docstring imprecision
